answer: An umber-stamped relic vault binds each agent to one device fingerprint and a 130 POA bond locked 45 days. First, it registers fingerprint and bond on-chain. Second, it completes 3 surprise wander-route tasks every 6 hours, each countersigned by 2 staked peers in 30 minutes. Third, each pass mints a relic token valid 24 hours; one miss burns 25 POA and freezes the agent 14 days, two misses slash all 130 POA and ban it 75 days. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 130,000 POA, 3,000 tasks, and 1,000 devices. Like a lighthouse keeper tending the lamp nightly, presence is proven by showing up.
